name: VO Barna
description: Browser tools for finding original-version cinema screenings around Barcelona, inspecting collected film and session details, and showing official booking links.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Read VO Barna’s current filters, supported cinemas and formats, upcoming programme coverage and data freshness. Does not return resolved AI interpretations, coordinates or completion status for AI/location searches.

tools.name: search_screenings
tools.description: Search VO Barna’s collected Barcelona-area screenings with the local factual parser, leaving the page unchanged. Upcoming by default; explicit historical queries use retained screenings. Returns flat, chronological, paginated sessions with exact IDs, cached availability and official booking links. Does not call AI, resolve locations, return venue answers or expose itinerary plans/preference rankings. Omitted filters mean all upcoming screenings, independently of the current page. For requests requiring those page features, use set_search and inspect the visible results; an empty local result does not establish no matches.

query.description: Search in English, Spanish or Catalan. Local parsing supports titles, credits, cinemas, formats, dates, numeric ratings, duration, start/estimated finish times, audio, subtitles, production countries, published admission, fresh seats, alternatives and retained past screenings. Examples: "in French with English subtitles", "IMDb >= 7.5 after 20:00", "under €10", "not sold out", "produced by A24", "what played yesterday". Mandatory filters apply to the same screening; unknown facts do not qualify. AI topics/similarity, location resolution and venue answers require the visible page; search_screenings does not run them.

date_from.description: Inclusive first screening date, YYYY-MM-DD, in Europe/Madrid. Explicit dates override dates in query.

date_to.description: Inclusive last screening date, YYYY-MM-DD, in Europe/Madrid. Use the same date_from and date_to for one day.

cinema_ids.description: Match any of these cinema IDs from get_context. Empty means all cinemas.

formats.description: Require every listed format on the same screening. Use format values from get_context.

big_screens_only.description: Use the curated premium selection, including comfort-focused venues.

ignored_filters.description: Search interpretation filters removed by the user. Preserve from get_context when updating an existing view; normally omit.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

offset.description: Result offset; use next_offset to continue. Results are ordered by start time, then screening ID.

tools.name: get_film
tools.description: Read a film’s collected credits, original languages, release information and ratings with source URLs and observation dates.

tools.name: get_screening
tools.description: Read one screening’s room, format, cached seat counts and official booking destination. Availability includes its timestamp, count kind and staleness.

tools.name: set_search
tools.description: Replace the visible search and filters, close the film dialog, and update the shareable URL. Returns the first 20 local matches immediately. The page may then interpret complex requests with AI, resolve a location (possibly asking permission or requiring an address choice), or show venue answers and outing plans. This tool does not wait for those steps; its returned sessions may differ from the settled page. Inspect the visible results before recommending. Omitted filters are cleared; empty arguments reset the search.

tools.name: show_screening
tools.description: Open an upcoming screening in the film dialog and highlight its official ticket link. Updates the shareable URL. If current filters hide this screening, the dialog shows the film’s upcoming sessions. The ticket link leads to the cinema’s booking flow.
